Configure proxy URL and successfully crawl through it

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"proxy\":{\"url\":\"http://127.0.0.1:8888\"},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
```
